subject: general
question: The 2024 philately scholarship scheme was launched by the Department of Posts under the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2024 philately scholarship scheme was launched by the Department of Posts under the Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana.**
 
• **Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana:**
 
 
• This scholarship scheme is **for students in classes 6–9 who have good academic records and pursue philately as a hobby.**
 
• The scheme aims to generate interest in philately among students.
